data.fund_type: An open ended debt scheme investing in government securities across maturity with relatively high interest rate risk andrelatively low credit risk
data.investment_objective: The objective of the Scheme is to generate credit risk-free returns through investments in sovereign securities issued by theCentral Government and/or State Government(s) and/or any security unconditionally guaranteed by the Government of India,and/or reverse repos in such securities as per applicable RBI Regulations and Guidelines. The Scheme may also be investing inReverse repo, Triparty repo on Government securities or treasury bills and/or other similar instruments as may be notiﬁed fromtime to time. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Government of India Securities/ State Government Securities, Treasury Bills and Cash Management Bills across maturity - 80% -100%, Other Debt Securities and Money Market Instruments* - 0% - 20% *Money market instruments will include commercialpapers, commercial bills, Triparty REPO, Reverse Repo and equivalent and any other like instruments as speciﬁed by SEBI andReserve Bank of India from time to time.
